description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents...“Hammock Bayou,” your peaceful hideaway in the exclusive Hammocks community of Seagrove Beach. Imagine mornings by the sparkling community pool, afternoons biking the scenic 30A trails, and evenings unwinding by the cozy fire pit. With 3 charming bedrooms, 4 bikes ready for adventure, and the magic of Seaside and Watercolor just minutes away, this is where beachside simplicity meets unforgettable moments. Ready to escape? Learn more below...👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Steps to the Community Pool – Relax and unwind with easy access to a refreshing dip just moments from your door. Perfect for lazy afternoons or fun with the family.4 Bikes for Exploring Scenic 30A – Discover the charm of 30A at your own pace. Cruise along picturesque paths and soak in the coastal beauty with every ride.Outdoor Fire Pit with Seating and Grill – Gather around for cozy evenings under the stars. Share stories, roast marshmallows, or enjoy a delicious barbecue in a welcoming outdoor space.Close to Seaside & Watercolor Attractions – Immerse yourself in the vibrant local culture, boutique shopping, and seaside dining just a short journey away.Sleeps 10 Comfortably – Plenty of room for everyone with 3 En-suites - 2 King and a Bunk Room with 2 Twin-over-King Beds.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Amazing property! The house is absolute perfection, and so is the location. We would rent this house again in a heartbeat!" – Dana R.⭐ "We felt like we were at home with trees all around in a quiet gated community. Everything was a manageable walk or bike ride to the beach!" – Lenaya T.⭐ "Perfect getaway! The house was beautiful, spacious, and with a personal touch. Loved how close it was to Seaside and the beach." – Lillie B.*** LIVING AREA ***Step into the serene oasis of Hammock Bayou, where an open-concept layout invites natural light to flood every corner, showcasing its carefully crafted design. The warm and inviting Living Room effortlessly transitions into a private, covered Porch, complete with comfortable outdoor seating. It’s the perfect spot to relax and recharge, whether you’re savoring your morning coffee or unwinding after a day of exploration.Spacious Open-Concept Living, Kitchen & Dining Area – Perfect for EntertainingCozy Private Covered Porch Overlooking Serene Wooded ViewsInviting Outdoor Fire Pit with Plush, Comfortable Seating for Memorable Evenings*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The gourmet kitchen is a paradise for food enthusiasts, boasting state-of-the-art stainless steel appliances, expansive counter space, and all the tools you need to craft culinary masterpieces. Savor your creations at the charming rustic dining table, or take your dining experience outdoors to enjoy alfresco meals by the cozy, glowing fire pit under the stars.Fully Equipped Gourmet Kitchen with Premium Stainless Steel Appliances for a Chef’s DelightSpacious Dining Table for 6 + Stylish Bar Seating for 3 – Perfect for EntertainingInviting Outdoor Dining Area with a High-Quality Grill & Comfortable Seating for 5 – Ideal for Alfresco Meals*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***The magic of Hammock Bayou truly comes to life outdoors. Just steps from your door, you’ll find a sparkling community pool, a cozy outdoor fire pit for gathering with friends and family, and a serene wooded backdrop that invites peace and tranquility. These thoughtfully designed outdoor spaces provide the perfect balance of relaxation and entertainment, making every moment unforgettable.Just steps away from the Community Pool – perfect for a quick dip or relaxing day in the sunCozy Outdoor Fire Pit with ample Lounge Seating – unwind under the starsPremium Propane Grill – ideal for outdoor cooking and hosting gatherings*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Whether you're traveling with friends, family, or little ones, the thoughtfully crafted bedroom layout provides generous space and exceptional privacy. Every detail has been designed to ensure maximum comfort, creating a relaxing and welcoming retreat where everyone can truly unwind and feel at home.1st Floor:Primary Suite: Luxurious King Bed, Private En-Suite with a Sleek Glass-Enclosed Shower2nd Floor:King Guest Suite: Elegant King Bed, Spacious En-Suite featuring a Glass-Enclosed Shower & Dual Sinks for added convenienceBunk Room: Fun and Functional with 2 Twin-over-King Bunk Beds, plus a Private En-Suite with a Shower/Bathtub Combo—perfect for families or groups*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Nestled within the exclusive gated community of The Hammocks, Hammock Bayou perfectly blends tranquility with modern convenience. Experience the serenity of nature while staying just moments away from charming boutique shops, exceptional local dining, and the breathtaking iconic 30A trails.Seagrove Beach East: A quick 11-minute walk takes you to this tranquil stretch of sand, ideal for soaking up the sun and enjoying the peaceful Gulf views.Seaside Shops & Beach: Only a 6-minute drive to the heart of Seaside, where charming boutiques, trendy shops, and a vibrant beach atmosphere await.Grayton Beach State Park: Just a 10-minute drive away, this serene destination offers stunning natural beauty, perfect for relaxing or exploring scenic trails.Nearby Restaurants & Boutiques: Surround yourself with a mix of local eateries and unique shops, adding a dash of excitement and flavor to your stay.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSVs (Low-Speed Vehicles) are NOT allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 16874STRO #: STR-016874
